caption:
Feel like there's nothing left of you but scraps? The Shepherd reaches in for the fragments. (Amos 3:12 devotional)

Even the fragment the lion left is what the Shepherd reaches in to save. You are not a discarded fragment.

📌 Save this for your quiet time
💬 What part of my life have I written off as too far gone to matter?
